title: Brick Decomposition For Semisimple Theta Data
body_html:
Brick Decomposition For Semisimple Theta Data

For a pre-semisimple character datum

$$ \Sigma=(V,\beta,\phi), $$

the theta draft uses a brick decomposition

$$ \beta=\bigoplus_i\beta_i, \qquad V=\bigoplus_i V_i, \qquad \Sigma=\bigoplus_i\Sigma_i. $$

The positive-depth part and depth-zero block are separated by the decomposition

$$ G^0={}^+G^0\times Z_G. $$

In inductive arguments, the draft often splits

$$ \Sigma=\Sigma_b\oplus\Sigma_a $$

where $\Sigma_b$ is the brick of maximal depth and $\Sigma_a$ is the remaining sum of lower-depth bricks.

Draft Caution

The TeX assumes the brick decomposition exists and has standard compatibility with centralizers, lattice functions, and Moy-Prasad filtrations. The current theta draft does not restate those foundations.
